label: DELIBERATELY LEAKY SPLIT -- demonstration only, not a result
what_this_is: A shuffled row split over 50%-overlapping windows, run to measure what the guarded splits prevent. Its test windows share samples with training windows by construction. See docs/DECISIONS.md D-017.
honest_split: temporal, guard 2 s, no shared samples
interpretation: A random split over overlapping windows scores 0.906 macro-F1, against 0.846 for the guarded temporal split on the same recordings: an inflation of 0.060. 90% of the random split's test windows share samples with a training window. The shuffled-label control on the random split reads 0.011 (chance 0.011).
